title: Homeostasis: Keeping the Body in Balance Practice Exam
description: Recall and guided drill for Homeostasis: Keeping the Body in Balance.

questions.question: Which statement best describes homeostasis?
options: The body keeps internal conditions within healthy ranges through active regulation.
The body keeps every condition at one exact number all day.
Only the skeletal system controls internal balance.
Homeostasis happens only when a person is asleep.
questions.explanation: Homeostasis is active regulation within safe ranges.

questions.question: A homeostatic condition can change slightly and still remain healthy.
questions.explanation: Healthy regulation usually works within a range, not a single unchanging number.

questions.question: A measurable sign such as body temperature or blood pressure is an example of a homeostasis ________.
questions.explanation: An indicator is something that can be measured or observed.

questions.question: After exercise, sweating helps the body mainly by
Explain why several body systems are involved in homeostasis.
questions.correctAnswer: Several systems are needed because detecting change, sending signals, moving materials, and carrying out responses require different organs working together.
questions.explanation: A strong answer connects homeostasis to cooperation among systems.

questions.question: Which pair is a good example of an indicator and response?
options: eye color changes; digestion stops forever
hair color changes; blood pressure cannot change
questions.explanation: The first pair shows a measurable change and a regulatory response.

questions.question: Homeostasis is important because cells work best only under certain internal conditions.
questions.explanation: Cells depend on suitable temperature, water, pH, nutrients, and oxygen.

questions.question: Give one everyday situation that shows homeostasis and identify the condition being regulated.
questions.correctAnswer: An acceptable answer names a real situation and the regulated condition, such as sweating on a hot day to regulate body temperature.
questions.explanation: The answer should include both the situation and the variable.
